application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.note: Released summary CSVs do not state chemistry.

units_released.note: Rule: one file per bus. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.note: Released summary CSVs do not state cell topology.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Released files contain bus-level summary values, not cell channels.

energy_mwh.note: No pack rating is present in the summary CSVs.

span_unit_years.note: Released summary CSVs contain no calendar timestamps.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.17632/j9ky68gnd3.3; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
